scenes.title: Your mission
scenes.caption: You will be a Data Detective! Ask questions, read graphs, find the centre, test chance.

scenes.title: The journey
scenes.caption: Your adventure has 5 steps. Finish one step to open the next.
scenes.heading: 5 steps. One at a time.
scenes.note: Finish a step to open the next one 🔓

scenes.title: The rooms
scenes.caption: These are the 6 rooms on your journey.
scenes.heading: 6 rooms to explore

rooms.name: Question Studio
rooms.text: Pick a question and make a guess.

rooms.name: Data Hub
rooms.text: Ask a pretend class. Watch the answers arrive.

rooms.name: Number Lab
rooms.text: Find the mean, median, mode and range.

rooms.name: Chance Lab
rooms.text: Flip, roll and spin to test chance.

rooms.name: Evidence Board
rooms.text: Say what you found and show your proof.

scenes.title: How to use it
scenes.caption: Stuck? Tap the hint button. Use an answer, change it, or write your own.
scenes.heading: How do I use it?
scenes.edit: I can see it on the graph.
calls: Tap an answer, or drag it into the box.
Change the words, or write it all yourself.
Tap 📖 any time to read about this room.
